name: my-better-robots-config
title: My Better Robots Config
author: Maximilian
description:
Easy changeable robot and roboports settings. 
 - Changeable Roboports Charging Number and Radius Places 
 - Changeable Worker and Logic Robots Flying Speed 
 - Changeable Worker and Logic Robots Energy Capacity (for longer Flying Time) 
 - Change Logic Chest Raduis to Roboports Construction Raduis (But Roboports connection Raduis is Normal)
